subject: design/execution-demand-contract-v1
statement: Projection writes one canonical `execution-demand-capsule/v1` marker into each supported tracker item's ordinary body before it can become routable. The capsule contains the complete canonical origin, exact plan/task identities and fingerprints, demand ID, codec version, and capsule digest. Both tracker adapters use the same codec and preserve the same logical bytes; they do not infer, merge, or default fields.
